## 1) Simple running number (DOC-0001, DOC-0002, …)

In cell A2:
```excel
="DOC-" & TEXT(ROW(A2)-1,"0000")
```

Copy down.  
Result:
- A2: DOC-0001  
- A3: DOC-0002  
- etc.

## 2) Include year (DOC-2026-0001, DOC-2026-0002, …)

In A2:
```excel

```

```excel

```

Copy A2 down.
